terra.problem: “The Call to Macedonia” takes place before Paul and his companions leave for Macedonia, not in Macedonia (Acts 16:8–11).
“Help from Silas and Timothy” takes place in Corinth, not Macedonia. The title also implies help that Acts 18:5–6 does not describe.
“Paul Returns to Macedonia” describes Paul leaving for Macedonia and later deciding to go back through it, but does not describe an event happening there. Acts 20:1–3 also does not name Ephesus.
Some wording is difficult for a fifth-grade reader, especially “devoted himself fully to the word, testifying” and “their joy overflowed into rich generosity.”
